en.autoUpdateDesc: When on, clicking the sidebar Update Copilot button immediately starts "Update all" if outdated plugins are found; the dsh core is never auto-updated (it updates only through an explicit confirm on its own card)
en.bundleNoChange: Bundle is already up to date
en.compatCurrent: Current DSH {v} no longer exports names these plugins import; the next boot may fail the whole plugin tree
en.compatDisable: Temporarily disable (append to that profile's cordis.patch.yml)
en.compatMissing: {file} imports {names} from {pkg}, which the host does not export
en.compatTarget: After upgrading to DSH {v}, these plugins may fail to load
en.coreDowngradeWarn: Careful: the target {v} is OLDER than the installed {cur} — this is a downgrade path and runs only after confirmation.
en.coreExecBlocked: Core update blocked by the gate
en.coreNoExec: This install shape ({method}) cannot be auto-updated — run the command manually
en.coreNotWritable: The npm global prefix is not writable (may need sudo) — run the command manually
en.corePolicy: Core updates run here for writable global npm installs (gated; a dsh restart is required afterwards) — other install shapes get the command only.
en.coreRestartHint: This process still runs the old {cur} — restart dsh (e.g. dsh web) for the new version to take effect.
en.errConfirm: Your explicit confirmation is required first
en.errLatestUnavailable: Could not resolve the latest version from npm. Try again shortly.
en.errLinked: Local link:/file: installs are not managed — update them inside their own checkout (git pull there)
en.errNoop: pnpm finished but nothing changed. Re-scan and retry; if it persists, share the output below for debugging.
en.errNotInstalled: Plugin is not installed in this profile
en.errOfficial: Official packages follow the dsh core — update dsh itself
en.errPreflightBlocked: Blocked: the target dsh no longer exports names this plugin imports — forcing can brick the whole profile at boot
en.errUnsafe: Target rejected by the safety policy
en.errUnsupportedChannel: This install channel is not auto-updatable yet.
en.errUpdateRunning: Another update is already running — try again shortly
en.forceHint: The update was blocked by preflight; evidence below (copyable disable patch / uninstall command)
en.liveBusy: An update is running — please wait
en.officialNote: Official packages follow the dsh core
en.patchAuditFix: Fix: change the entry's name to the current package name, or delete the name line so it matches by id (both verified to work)
en.patchAuditTitle: Patch-name check: {n} cordis.patch.yml entr(ies) pin package names that no longer exist — the loader silently skips them (config included)
en.progress_waiting: Waiting for the server… (older server, no live progress)
en.queuedHint: An update is running — this item is queued and starts automatically when it finishes
en.quickUpdateTitle: Click to update every outdated plugin
en.restartHint: Restart dsh (e.g. dsh web) after plugin updates to apply them
en.riskCollateral: collateral (not the update target — likely hit by shared-dependency rewriting)
en.subtitle: Version radar for the DeepSeek Harness core and plugins (merged across profiles)
en.updateRiskHint: Suggested: append a disable patch, or uninstall
